WINDRUSH LINE: Monday 26, Tuesday 27, Wednesday 28 and Thursday 29 October, after 2330 each evening, no service between New Cross Gate and West Croydon / Crystal Palace. Rail replacement buses will run as follows: The bus for Crystal Palace will depart London Bridge at 2358 calling at New Cross Gate, Brockley, Honor Oak Park, Forest Hill, Sydenham, Crystal Palace, Gipsy Hill, West Norwood, Tulse Hill and Streatham Hill. The bus for East Croydon will depart London Bridge at 0035 calling at New Cross Gate, Brockley, Honor Oak Park, Forest Hill, Sydenham, Norwood Junction and East Croydon (Arr 01:27). One return bus from Crystal Palace departs at 2359, calling at all stations to London Bridge via New Cross Gate. Alternatively, use local buses or trams via any reasonable route. 
The 2232 and 2247 trains from Highbury & Islington to West Croydon will both divert to Crystal Palace. The 2338 train from Dalston Junction to New Cross Gate will not run
